## Confirmed findings            ← consumed by super-design, one task per finding
- [Should-fix] skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:254 — Review collection follows symlinked archive destination directories, writes new review files outside the run archive, and reports collection complete. [lanes: security]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: Three frozen-head probes created outside/new-file.txt through reviews/probe/payload, returned exit 0 with collection complete and complete:true/gaps:[], and ordinary status returned clean. The collector validates source components but not destination ancestors before mkdirSync/copyFileSync. The prior source-read symlink finding is fixed; this destination-write escape is introduced by the current collector. Evidence: /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-0-reproduce/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-0-refute/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-0-ground/destination-receipt.json; skills/super-auto/SKILL.md:461; run-state.md:214.
  fix-shape hint: Validate each destination path component before creating or copying archived review files.
- [Blocking] skills/super-code/coordinator.js:1830 — A verification-only task stacked on an unmerged parent deadlocks the coordinator when it holds the last scheduler slot and that parent merge fails. [lanes: concurrency-async]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: Independent full-coordinator simulations stall after both reviews when a verification-only child holds the sole slot awaiting parentsMerged, while parent failure handling needs that slot to resolve the promise. Controls with an ordinary child, a successful parent merge, or capacity 2 complete. The supported concurrency=1 path therefore prevents cancellation, reopen, triage, and round completion. Evidence: /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-1-reproduce/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-1-refute/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-1-ground/receipt.json; coordinator-workflow.md:564-570.
  fix-shape hint: Release the child task slot before waiting for parent merge settlement, or otherwise let failure settlement run without that slot.
- [Should-fix] skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:131 — Root acceptance discards retained attribution contradictions whenever the failure's current classification is pre-run, allowing eligibility before that conflicting source history is reconciled. [lanes: correctness]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: The actual classifier retains a pre-run classification while adding a run-introduced/pre-run conflict for pass and fail observations at the same baseline tree. The unmodified acceptance command then exits 0 with eligible:true, pending:[], gaps:[], while changing only classification to gap exposes the contradiction and exits 3. The required final suite is a different command and does not detect this targeted conflict. Evidence: /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-2-reproduce/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-2-refute/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-2-ground/reproduction-output.json; run-state.md:274-277; coordinator-workflow.md:700-704.
  fix-shape hint: Preserve attribution gaps from pre-run failures when same-tree pass/fail history remains contradictory.
- [Should-fix] skills/super-code/scripts/dispatch-text.mjs:319 — Persisted immutable review-source bindings are recovered as deferred measurement obligations, causing otherwise satisfied root acceptance to fail for missing measurement identity. [lanes: simplicity-design, regression, data-migrations] [fix-regression]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: The real bind-review-source CLI writes a provenance-only deferred record; ledger-digest and recovery preserve it as an obligation without measurement identity. A satisfied synthetic acceptance control passes, but adding only the recovered binding makes the real acceptance CLI exit 3 with the sole gap “review-source: measurement identity unavailable.” The fixture does not assert actual run acceptance. Evidence: /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-3-reproduce/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-3-refute/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-3-ground/receipt.json; run-state.md:225-230.
  fix-shape hint: Give review-source provenance a defined recovery disposition that does not require measurement fields it does not contain.
- [Should-fix] skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status:206 — The collection CLI cannot reconcile a settled null review result to its recovered report, so valid report recovery leaves the required collection gate pending. [lanes: api-contract]
  verdict: confirmed (reproduce ✓ / refute ✗-survived / ground ✓)
  evidence: After settling a required review as UNAVAILABLE, supplying the recovered review path is rejected as an identity change; replay archives the report but retains the null reconciliation gap. A fresh collection of identical bytes succeeds. This prevents the documented recovery path from clearing collection status before a subsequent invocation or cleanup. Evidence: /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-5-reproduce/receipt.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-5-refute/receipts.json, /tmp/ufz-pr2-controller/judge-5-ground/receipt.json; skills/super-auto/SKILL.md:390, 465; run-state.md:210-214; resume.md:29-31.
  fix-shape hint: Add a supported reconciliation transition that associates a recovered report with the settled null result while preserving its history.
